settings.start_rule: random reading (no repeats) where the true glucose is inside the fault's range and the whole episode fits in the trace
settings.dose_rule: version 2 calculator at the version 2 decision times (wizard records inside the episode)
settings.episode_rule: version 2: 15 min beyond the threshold starts an episode; an alert within 30 min of a true start, or inside the true episode, counts as shown
settings.aggregation: per participant: total over episodes / number of episodes (per episode) and / hours of readings the fault changed (per affected hour); then median, q1, q3, mean across participants
settings.affected_hour: one hour of readings that the fault applies to (fault: readings in the fault's glucose range inside the episode; bias and no fault: all readings in the episode)

false_low.rule: true glucose 70 to 250 mg/dL: sensor shows true x (1 + error), not below the floor
false_low.source: h_malf_vs_serious_errors.csv, row All / malfunction, column median_pct_reads_low (median of malfunction-only pairs where the sensor read below the meter). Quartiles: interpolated from the 10-point bins in h_error_distribution.csv (All / malfunction, bins up to 0 %).
false_low.note: No table holds 'meter 70 to 250 and sensor reading low' exactly. This is the nearest documented group.

hidden_low.rule: true glucose under 54 mg/dL: sensor shows true x (1 + error), not above the display maximum
hidden_low.source: g_brand_error_sizes.csv, row serious / All / sensor above meter (median, q1, q3 of error in % of the meter value).
hidden_low.note: No table holds 'meter under 54' or 'meter under 70' with 'sensor 70 or above' exactly. This is the nearest documented group (see fda_evidence.serious_sensor_above_meter for its meter values).

floor_pinned.rule: true glucose over 250 mg/dL: sensor shows the floor
floor_pinned.source: Floor = 39 mg/dL = DEVICE_MIN in analysis/simulation_v2.py (lowest value a sensor may show there). REGEX_V2_FULL_CORPUS.md quotes 'LO (LESS THAN 40 MG/DL)'. Small case = not pinned: median error of serious pairs where the sensor read below the meter (g_brand_error_sizes.csv, row serious / All / sensor below meter).
floor_pinned.note: The floor is the lowest value a sensor can show, so there is no larger case.

outcomes.sugar_unneeded_n: sugar treatments taken while the true glucose was 70 or above (count)
outcomes.sugar_unneeded_g: the same in grams (15 g each)
outcomes.dose_lower_n: correction doses withheld or reduced: the dose fell by more than 0.5 U (count)
outcomes.dose_withheld_n: correction doses withheld: true dose above 0.5 U, faulted dose 0 (count; part of dose_lower_n)
outcomes.dose_lower_u: insulin not given, summed over all decisions with a lower dose (units)
outcomes.insulin_true_low_n: decisions where the true glucose was under 70 and the fault raised the dose (count)
outcomes.low70_missed_n: true low episodes under 70 with no low alert shown (count)
outcomes.low54_missed_n: true low episodes under 54 with no under-54 alert shown (count)
outcomes.min_under54_no_alert: minutes with true glucose under 54 while the sensor showed 70 or above
outcomes.low70_false_n: low alerts under 70 shown with no true low episode (count)
outcomes.low54_false_n: low alerts under 54 shown with no true episode under 54 (count)
outcomes.high180_missed_n: true high episodes over 180 never shown as high (count)
outcomes.min_over180_not_shown: minutes with true glucose over 180 while the sensor showed 180 or under

3_reference_minus20_vs_version2.how: this run: -20 % bias in the 12-hour false-low windows, median per hour of readings x 24. version 2: -20 % bias on the whole trace, median per day (simulation_v2_lookup.csv).
